body: 3b6650e speed scaling per stat/fatigue is the cheapest multiplier — AnimationPlayer.speed_scale set from fighter speed + fatigue buys 3-5x apparent variety per clip for ~20 lines of code, zero art, fully deterministic. Additive fatigue layer (one authored delta clip) is the highest ceiling but needs retarget reference-pose verification. No published speed-variance tolerance found; +/-15%% is INFERENCE. No fighting-game sources found (all blocked); technique rankings are INFERENCE.
